questions.stem: What is a stent used for in the treatment of coronary heart disease?

options.text: To replace a damaged heart valve
To hold open a narrowed coronary artery and restore blood flow
To reduce the amount of cholesterol in the blood
To prevent electrical signals from reaching the ventricles

questions.explanation: A stent is a small mesh tube inserted into a narrowed coronary artery. It holds the artery open, allowing blood to flow more freely to the heart muscle and reducing the risk of a heart attack.
